newsitem.title: UK: UK's George says little risk of 80s-style boom.
newsitem.headline: UK's George says little risk of 80s-style boom.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said he did not believe Britain was on the verge of a 1980s-style econonomic boom.
Asked by the House of Commons Treasury Select Committee if he thought this was likely, he replied: "No -- not an 80s-type boom. That's talking about intensity."

"I think we're on the verge of a domestically driven upswing. We've said that very clearly and set it out very clearly in the Inflation Report. But I don't believe that the parallels in terms of an 80s-type boom, I don't think that they're reasonable."
